title: ericameria × viscosa
intro: Ericameria × viscosa, commonly known as Sticky Chrysothamnus, is a hybrid plant species that combines characteristics of Ericameria arborescens and Chrysothamnus viscidiflorus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Ericameria × viscosa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cytotoxic activity against cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
